title: primary-source-verification doc-findings
description: The per-claim verdict packet psv emits. EXTENDS cross-source-review's doc-findings (a STRICT SUPERSET — csr's 6 `kind` values are preserved byte-for-byte; psv adds `claim-refuted` / `claim-narrowed` / `claim-unverifiable`). Field shape is identical to csr's (defect_id / severity / kind / location / evidence / suggestion) so a psv packet composes with csr's process-axis findings. The EVIDENCE STANDARD IS RAISED for psv's added kinds: a `claim-refuted` (severity blocker) or `claim-narrowed` (severity warning) finding MUST cite a FETCHED-SOURCE QUOTE in `evidence`, not model recall — a finding lacking a fetched quote is downgraded to `claim-unverifiable` (severity coverage), never asserted (workspace rule 3 + L1; enforced by fetched_quote_gate.py). `claim-unverifiable` is a KIND (an artifact claim no fetchable source could adjudicate), DISTINCT from csr's `coverage-gap` KIND (a missing-section defect in the artifact) and from the `coverage` SEVERITY (the reviewer's own honest disclosure). `verified` claims are NOT findings (no defect); they are counted in the coverage-record. The reviewer/extractor/comparator NEVER edits the artifact — this JSON is psv's sole output. Validated in infra/test/findings_shape_check.py.

outcome_axis_respected.description: psv asserts it did NOT judge outcome-axis questions (whether the doc is 'right' / the conclusion is true). True on every conformant run — psv verifies per-claim against a fetched source; it does not certify global truth.

findings.description: One entry per refuted / narrowed / unverifiable claim. `verified` claims are NOT findings. Empty when every admissible claim verified.

severity.description: blocker = claim-refuted (real contradiction, needs a fetched quote); warning = claim-narrowed (source supports a weaker form, needs a fetched quote); coverage = claim-unverifiable (could not adjudicate — honest disclosure, rule 3). A quote-less refuted/narrowed finding is downgraded to coverage/claim-unverifiable.

kind.description: csr's 6 doc-domain kinds (preserved) PLUS psv's 3 claim-verdict kinds. claim-refuted = fetched source contradicts the claim; claim-narrowed = fetched source supports a weaker form; claim-unverifiable = no fetchable source adjudicates it (interpretive / paywalled / judgment call — escalate to human). NOTE: claim-unverifiable the KIND (a claim the source could not settle) is DISTINCT from coverage-gap the KIND (a missing-section defect) and from coverage the SEVERITY.

location.description: Where the claim lives in the artifact (section heading, line range, or anchor id) AND the adjudicating source ref (arXiv id / Crossref / repo file / spec section).

evidence.description: (For the 6 csr-preserved kinds the evidence standard is csr's — a concrete artifact/source quote; psv's own packets emit only the 3 claim-verdict kinds below.) For claim-refuted / claim-narrowed: a QUOTE from the FETCHED source + the claim text + why they conflict/diverge. A Blocker/Warning of these kinds with no fetched quote is downgraded to claim-unverifiable. For claim-unverifiable: what was claimed and why no fetchable source could adjudicate it.

suggestion.description: Optional one-line fix direction. psv does NOT apply it (report-only).
